metadata.title: Az.StorageTable
metadata.description: Sample functions to add/retrieve/update entities on Azure Storage Tables from PowerShell. It requires latest Azure PowerShell module installed, which can be downloaded follow https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/azure/install-az-ps?view=azps-1.3.0.
